purpose: Estimate analytical-reference N192-to-N256/N384 shell magnitudes and the M384-to-M768 sampling discrepancy over strict N384.

sampled_timestep_screen.quantity: max over the completed exact-reference sample grid of sum_i abs(u_i)
sampled_timestep_screen.candidate: largest dyadic tick count over 2^20 below the sampled guard limit
sampled_timestep_screen.scope: non-rigorous stage-bound planning sample only; every PDE trajectory must enforce its actual step guard independently
sampled_timestep_screen.earlier_clocks: not sampled by this clock4096 screen

comparison.metadata_caveat: The reusable comparator receives grid/sample labels externally; direct-reference files have no workers, so the command supplies workers=0 and binds both files by printed SHA-256.

commands_after_cpu_release.compare_template: (ulimit -v 7340032; timeout 180s work/p10-reference-n384-target/release/p10-force-snapshot-tool-n384 compare LEFT_M384 RIGHT_M768 4096 384 384 384 768 0 0 LEFT_SHA256 RIGHT_SHA256)

launch_rule: Do not start while the four endpoint PDE jobs own the CPU. Run M384 and M768 independently, then compare their retained strict-N384 files only after both exit zero and hashes are recorded.
